scope: Require an active manager account for profile administration and recurrence changes.
finding: The domain checked the manager role for profile edits and recurrence revisions but did not verify that the manager account remained active.
changes: Profile updates now require an active manager.
Recurring assignment revisions now require an active manager.
Regression checks reject both operations when the manager profile is inactive.

cases: Inactive manager cannot revise a recurring assignment.
Inactive manager cannot update an employee profile.
